name: Intercompany Cost Allocation - Data Element Inventory
purpose: Field-level data dictionary for an operational transfer pricing (OTP) cost-to-charge engine. Covers OECD Chapter VII intra-group services and US Treas. Reg. 1.482-9. Entities link via the PK/FK relationships noted per field.

entities.title: 1. Cost Line (source GL / ACDOCA)
entities.description: Stage 1 capture. The atomic input: each cost the provider entity incurred, tagged so the rest of the pipeline can pool, gate, and allocate it.

fields.definition: Unique identifier for the source cost line.
fields.relevance: Audit lineage: every charge must trace back to its constituent cost lines.

fields.definition: Legal entity that bore the cost.
fields.relevance: Determines who is providing the service and recovering the cost.
Primary join key to the universal journal / ACDOCA.

fields.definition: Cost center the cost posted to.
fields.relevance: Drives the cost-center -> service-line mapping (function derivation).
fields.key_notes: Joins on natural key (company_code + cost_center), as-of period

fields.definition: GL account / cost element (nature of cost).
fields.relevance: Distinguishes payroll, depreciation, third-party fees, etc. for cost-base composition.

fields.definition: Classified nature (payroll, depreciation, third-party fee, travel, software...).
fields.relevance: Needed to identify pass-throughs and to define what is loaded into the cost base.

fields.definition: Service function the cost supports (IT, HR, Finance, Legal...).
fields.relevance: Routes the cost to the correct pool; usually carried by cost-center mapping not by account.

fields.definition: Cost amount in the provider's local/booking currency.
fields.relevance: The raw value that becomes the cost base.
Needed before any FX conversion at charge-out.
Pooling and charging cadence; budget vs. actual matching.

fields.definition: Fiscal year (stored as text to avoid numeric formatting).
Classifies the flow: service / goods / royalty / CSA / financing.
fields.relevance: Gate at Stage 1 - only 'service' flows enter this pipeline.
Routes traceable costs around the allocation key.

fields.definition: Recipient entity when the cost is directly traceable (direct charge).
fields.relevance: Populated only for direct charges; bypasses the key.

fields.definition: TRUE if cost is a disbursement advanced for a recipient.
fields.relevance: Pass-throughs recharge at cost with NO markup and must not dilute the pool.

fields.definition: Pool the line is assigned to (Stage 2).
fields.relevance: Links the line to its homogeneous pool.

fields.definition: Reference to the source GL document.

entities.title: 2. Cost Center -> Service Line Mapping (reference data)
entities.description: Versioned, effective-dated reference data. The single biggest determinant of data quality - keep it first-class, not a hard-coded lookup.

fields.definition: Company code scope of the mapping.

fields.key_notes: Natural key joined FROM 1_CostLine.cost_center (with company_code), as-of period

fields.definition: Service line / pool the cost center feeds.

fields.relevance: Used where service_line is not 1:1 with function.

fields.definition: Split % when a cost center serves multiple functions/pools.
fields.relevance: Supports impure cost centers by splitting them into homogeneous pools.
Effective-dating so historic charges remain reproducible.

fields.definition: Why the cost center maps as it does.
fields.relevance: Documentation byproduct for the local file.

entities.title: 3. Service Pool / Catalogue
entities.description: Stage 2-5 definition object. One pool ~ one service line ~ one beneficiary population ~ one key. Carries characterization driving markup policy.

fields.definition: Service category (IT, HR, Finance, Procurement, Mgmt...).
fields.relevance: Drives key catalogue and benchmarking comparables.

fields.definition: Description of what the pool delivers.

fields.relevance: Recovers cost + markup; revenue side of the charge.
Selects which markup regime applies (5% / 0% / benchmarked).
LVAIGS and SCM both require non-core; feeds business-judgment rule.

fields.definition: TRUE if pool uses/creates unique & valuable intangibles.
TRUE if pool involves assumption of significant risk.
Full cost / total services cost / marginal.
fields.relevance: Defines what the markup is applied to; frequent audit target.

fields.definition: Default allocation key for the pool.
TRUE if pool is charged directly (no key).

entities.title: 4. Markup Policy (per pool, per jurisdiction)
entities.description: Stage 5. Markup is a per-pool, per-jurisdiction attribute - the same pool can be LVAIGS 5% for an OECD leg and SCM 0% for the US leg.

fields.definition: Markup applied to the cost base.

fields.relevance: Required to support a US SCM (0%) position.

fields.definition: Conclusion that service is not core/key-advantage/fundamental-risk.

entities.title: 5. Exclusion Rules (benefit-test gating)
entities.description: Stage 3. The gating filter that strips non-chargeable cost from the pool. Supports partial (percentage) carve-outs - stewardship is rarely a clean cost center.

fields.relevance: Categorizes why the cost is not chargeable.
Enables stewardship carve-out from an otherwise chargeable pool.
Documentation; the most litigated area of services TP.

entities.title: 6. Allocation Key Definition
entities.description: Stage 4 metadata. Defines the apportionment factor and where its data comes from. Separate from the period key values (sheet 7).

fields.definition: Driver: headcount / revenue / seats / transactions / floor area / spend / multi-factor.
fields.relevance: Should proxy the benefit derived from the specific service.
Defines composite keys for diffuse-benefit pools.

fields.definition: Authoritative source for the factor data.
fields.relevance: Key integrity = second most common audit failure after impure pools.

fields.definition: Set annually (static) vs. recomputed each period (dynamic).
fields.relevance: Trades stability against accuracy; document the choice.

entities.title: 7. Allocation Key Value (per recipient, per period)
entities.description: Stage 4 data. The actual factor values that produce each recipient's apportionment ratio. Auditable, period-stamped, sourced.

fields.definition: Pool/beneficiary population the ratio is computed within.
fields.relevance: Denominator is scoped to the pool's beneficiaries.
Aligns key to the charge period.

fields.definition: Sum of factor across all pool beneficiaries.

fields.relevance: Share of pool allocated to this recipient.

fields.definition: Snapshot date of the factor data.
Reference to the underlying data extract.
fields.relevance: Audit lineage for the key data.

entities.title: 8. Legal Entity Master
entities.description: Reference data for providers and recipients. Effective-dated to handle incorporations, disposals, and restructurings mid-year.

fields.relevance: Drives markup policy and WHT/VAT treatment.
Sets topological order of allocation runs.

entities.title: 9. Pool Participation (entity <-> pool)
entities.description: Associative entity defining the beneficiary population of each pool and provider role, effective-dated. Scopes the allocation denominator.

fields.relevance: Defines who pays vs. who recovers.

fields.definition: Why the entity benefits from the pool.

fields.relevance: Handles mid-year entry/exit from a pool.

entities.title: 10. Charge Ledger (output)
entities.description: Stage 6 output. The intercompany charge produced for each provider/recipient/pool/period, with markup, FX, and indirect-tax attributes.

fields.relevance: In-year vs. year-end recompute; true-up tracking.
Ties back to pooled GL cost.
FX policy must be fixed and logged.

fields.definition: Withholding tax rate on the gross charge.
fields.relevance: Some jurisdictions levy WHT on service charges.
Required for VAT/customs in many jurisdictions.
Links true-up deltas to in-year charges.
Documentation as a byproduct of the run.

entities.title: 11. Reconciliation & Audit Log
entities.description: Stage 7. Per pool/provider/period tie-out of pooled cost to charges, with the unallocated residual as a control metric and full run lineage.

fields.definition: Gross cost captured in the pool.

fields.relevance: Should equal pooled cost less exclusions less residual.

fields.definition: Pool cost neither charged nor excluded.
fields.relevance: Red-flag KPI: trapped stewardship or pooling gap.

conventions.field_naming: snake_case; data_element values are usable directly as column names
conventions.enum_validation: Every field with data_type 'Enum' validates against the enumerations array
conventions.effective_dating: Reference entities carry effective_from/effective_to; runs must resolve reference data as-of the run period
conventions.source_of_truth: This JSON is the source of truth for codegen; the .md is the human-readable rendering
